property.name: fs.contract.supports-append
property.description: BOS does not support appending to existing files. Object stores generally do not support append operations.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-concat
property.description: BOS does not support concatenating multiple files into one.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-truncate
property.description: BOS does not support truncating files.

property.name: fs.contract.is-blobstore
property.description: BOS is an object/blob store, not a real filesystem. This means files are only visible after close(), not after create() or flush().

property.name: fs.contract.create-visibility-delayed
property.description: BOS files are not visible until after close() is called. This is standard behavior for object stores.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-hflush
property.description: BOS does not support hflush(). Data is only persisted on close().

property.name: fs.contract.supports-hsync
property.description: BOS does not support hsync(). Data is only persisted on close().

property.name: fs.contract.supports-seek
property.description: BOS supports random access (seek) operations on files.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-seek-on-closed-file
property.description: BOS allows seek operations on closed files (will fail on subsequent read).

property.name: fs.contract.rejects-seek-past-eof
property.description: BOS will throw an exception when seeking past end of file.

property.name: fs.contract.is-case-sensitive
property.description: BOS paths are case-sensitive.

property.name: fs.contract.is-banded-seek
property.description: BOS does not use banded seeking.

property.name: fs.contract.rename-overwrites-dest
property.description: BOS rename will overwrite the destination if it exists. Note: This is implemented via copy + delete.

property.name: fs.contract.rename-returns-false-if-source-missing
property.description: BOS rename returns false if source does not exist.

property.name: fs.contract.rename-returns-false-if-dest-parent-missing
property.description: BOS rename will create parent directories of destination if needed. This is set to false because rename-creates-dest-dirs is true.

property.name: fs.contract.rename-remove-dest-if-empty-dir
property.description: BOS rename will remove destination if it is an empty directory.

property.name: fs.contract.rename-creates-dest-dirs
property.description: BOS rename will create parent directories of destination if needed.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-atomic-delete
property.description: BOS delete operations are not atomic (implemented via multiple API calls).

property.name: fs.contract.supports-atomic-rename
property.description: BOS rename is not atomic (implemented via copy + delete).

property.name: fs.contract.create-overwrites-directory
property.description: BOS create() will not overwrite a directory.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-getfilestatus
property.description: BOS supports getFileStatus operation.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-block-locality
property.description: BOS provides block location information (though it may be synthetic).

property.name: fs.contract.is-emulated-directory
property.description: BOS emulates directories in object storage mode. Directories are not immediately visible until explicitly created.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-unix-permissions
property.description: BOS does not fully support Unix-style permissions. Note: Hierarchical namespace buckets have limited permission support.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-strict-exceptions
property.description: BOS throws specific exception types (FileNotFoundException, etc.) rather than generic IOException.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-symlinks
property.description: BOS does not support symbolic links.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-xattr
property.description: BOS does not support extended attributes (xattrs).

property.name: fs.contract.supports-availablebytes
property.description: BOS InputStream supports available() method.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-content-summary
property.description: BOS supports getContentSummary() operation.

property.name: fs.contract.test-root-tests-enabled
property.description: Root directory tests are disabled for BOS to avoid destructive operations on the bucket root.

property.name: fs.contract.supports-unbuffer
property.description: BOS does not support the unbuffer() operation on streams.
